traits.name: -2 Intelligence, +2 Charisma, +2 Constitution
traits.text: Ghorans are hardy, guileful, and eager to explore their emotions, but they process complex thoughts slowly.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Ghorans have the plant type but lack the immunities to mind-affecting, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, and stunning effects that type usually has. The plant type features immunities that, when granted to a player character race, can be disruptive and overpowered.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Ghorans are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Ghorans have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Ghorans begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Ghorans with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages such as Druidic).

traits.name: +2 Natural Armor
traits.text: Ghorans have tough, rugged skin and so gain a +2 Natural Armor bonus to AC.

traits.name: Past-Life Knowledge(Ex)
traits.text: Ghorans have memories encoded in their seeds. They treat all Knowledge skills as class skills.

traits.name: Natural Magic (Sp)
traits.text: Ghorans with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day-detect poison, goodberry (created berries bud from the ghoran's own body), and purify food and drink. The caster level is equal to the ghoran's level. The DC for these spells is equal to 10 + the spell's level + the ghoran's Charisma bonus.

traits.name: Light Dependent
traits.text: Ghorans are heavily light dependent and so take 1d4 points of Constitution damage each day they go without exposure to sunlight.

traits.name: Delicious (Ex)
traits.text: Ghorans take a -2 penalty on Escape Artist and combat maneuver checks to escape a grapple against a creature that has a bite attack with the grab ability.

traits.name: Seed (Ex)
traits.text: As a full-round action, a ghoran can expel the seed from an orifice in its abdomen. If planted in fertile ground and left undisturbed for 2d6 days, the seed grows into a healthy duplicate of the original ghoran, save that the duplicate can reallocate all skill ranks upon sprouting. Once a ghoran expels this seed, it gains 1 negative level, and it dies as soon as the duplicate sprouts. This duplicate replaces the previous ghoran character.

alternate_traits.name: Creator’s Legacy
alternate_traits.text: Infused with the druidic magic of their creator, ghorans quickly take to nature-based spells and spellcasting. Ghoran bloodragers and sorcerers with the verdant bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for sorcerer spells and class abilities. Ghoran clerics and druids with the Plant domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level. This doesn't give the ghoran early access to level-based powers; it affects only powers that could already be used without this trait. This replaces past-life knowledge. Source PZO1140

alternate_traits.name: Disgusting
alternate_traits.text: Some ghorans' link to their past lives becomes corrupted, causing their taste to become particularly disgusting. Such ghorans gain a +2 racial bonus on Escape Artist and combat maneuver checks to escape a grapple against any creature that has a bite attack with the grab ability. This racial trait replaces delicious and past-life knowledge. Source PZO9280

alternate_traits.name: Fecund Earth
alternate_traits.text: Ghorans were created to provide nourishment to creatures, but Ghorus also intended for the ghorans to help the land around them to grow and thrive. Once per day, a ghoran with this racial trait can cast plant growth as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to the ghoran's character level. This replaces past-life knowledge and nature magic. Source PPC:WO

alternate_traits.name: Intoxicating Aroma
alternate_traits.text: Some ghorans have an incredibly distracting scent. Once per day, as a spell-like ability, a ghoran with this racial trait can emit an intoxicating aroma that causes creatures within 30 feet to be fascinated for 1d4 rounds. Each target creature within range can attempt a Will save (DC = 10 + half the ghoran's character level + the ghoran's Charisma modifier) to negate the effect. This replaces natural magic. Source PPC:WO

alternate_traits.name: Magical Absorption
alternate_traits.text: Many ghorans are resistant to magic or able to dispel it. Some ghorans even gain nourishment from absorbing magic. Whenever such a ghoran succeeds at a saving throw against a spell or spell-like ability, she regains 1 hit point per level of the spell, though this affects the ghoran only if she is above 0 hit points. A ghoran can use this ability a number of times per day equal to her level. This replaces past-life knowledge and nature magic. Source PPC:WO

alternate_traits.name: Martial Recollection (Ex)
alternate_traits.text: The personal history of many ghorans is scarred with desperate struggles for survival, and memories of that conflict are deeply ingrained within their seeds. Whenever ghorans with this racial trait grow new bodies from their seeds, they reselect all combat feats known instead of reallocating skill ranks. This alters seed and replaces nature magic.

alternate_traits.name: Natural Camouflage
alternate_traits.text: Some ghorans evolve by reseeding themselves in different locations. With each new seed, these ghorans take on some of the traits of the areas surrounding their new growth. Ghorans with this racial trait choose one terrain from the ranger's favored terrain list other than planes, urban, or water. These ghorans gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks when in their chosen terrain. This replaces natural armor. Source PPC:WO

alternate_traits.name: Occult Scion
alternate_traits.text: Created in part from an esoteric ritual, many ghorans are innately sensitive to psychic powers and influences. The ghoran gains Psychic Sensitivity as a bonus feat and treats Knowledge (arcana) and Knowledge (planes) as class skills. This replaces past-life knowledge. Source PZO1140

alternate_traits.name: Spelleater
alternate_traits.text: Ghorans were originally created to survive and thrive in a magic-blasted wasteland, and over the centuries some ghorans have adapted greater abilities to overcome magic in general. Once per day, the ghoran can cast dispel magic as a spell-like ability, with a caster level equal to the ghoran's character level. If the ghoran's favored class is a spellcasting class, the ghoran gains a +2 racial bonus on dispel checks. This replaces past-life knowledge and nature magic. Source PZO1140

favored_class_options.text: When casting spells that target plants or plant creatures, add 1/3 to the effective caster level, but only for the purpose of determining duration. Source PZO1140
Add 1 skill rank to the hunter's plant companion. If the hunter replaces her plant companion, the new plant companion gains these bonus skill ranks. Source PZO1140

Choose one mind-affecting mesmerist trick that the mesmerist knows. The mesmerist can affect intelligent plant creatures with that trick or spell as if they weren't immune to mind-affecting effects. Source PZO1140
Add a +1/4 bonus on initiative checks and Survival checks when the ranger is in a favored terrain. Source PZO1140

Choose one type of ranger favored enemy (or one subtype in case of either humanoid or outsider). The rogue adds 1/2 to her sneak attack damage when using sneak attack against creatures of the chosen type (maximum +3). Source PZO1140

Add one spell from the druid spell list that isn't on the shaman spell list to the list of spells she knows. This spell must be at least 1 level lower than the highest-level spell the shaman can cast. Source PZO1140
Add 1/5 to the shifter's natural armor bonus when using wild shape to assume a major form. Source PZO1140
When casting sorcerer/wizard spells that are also on the druid spell list, add 1/3 to the effective class level, but only for the purpose of determining durations. Source PZO1140
Add 1/4 to the witch's caster level when attempting dispel checks using dispel magic, break enchantment, and similar effects. Source PZO1140

traits.name: Small
traits.text: Grindylows are Small creatures. They gain a +1 size bonus to AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Grindylows can scuttle about on land with their tentacles and have a base speed of 15 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Grindylows begin play speaking Aquan. Grindylows with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Common, and Goblin.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Grindylows have tough, rubbery skin that grants a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Swim Speed
traits.text: Grindylows have a swim speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Jet (1 RP)
traits.text: Grindylows can swim 200 feet backward as a full-round action. A grindylow must move in a straight line when jetting and does not provoke attacks of opportunity when using this ability.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.text: Grindylows have a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Grindylows have a natural bite attack that deals 1d3 points of damage. This bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the creature is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Tangling Tentacles
traits.text: (4 RP): Grindylows have constantly writhing tentacles that reach out to tug at and trip adjacent foes. During the grindylow's turn, it can make a single trip attack against any adjacent foe as a swift action. The grindylow gains a +4 racial bonus on trip attacks with its tangling tentacles, and if it fails to trip a foe, that creature can't attempt to trip the grindylow in retaliation.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Grindylows have darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Grindylows have the aquatic subtype, but they can breathe both water and air.

traits.name: +2 Constitution, +2 Dexterity, -2 Intelligence
traits.text: Kuru are abnormally fast and hardy, but bloodlust clouds their thinking. Kura gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, and -2 Intelligence.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Kuru are Humanoid creatures with both the kuru subtypes.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Kuru are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Kuru have a base speed of 40 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Kuru begin play speaking Kuru. Kuru with high Intelligence scores can choose bonus languages from the following: Abyssal, Common, Polyglot, Undercommon.

traits.name: Blood Courage (Ex)
traits.text: Once per day when a kuru makes a saving throw against a fear effect, he can roll the saving throw twice and take the better result. He must decide to use this ability before the saving throw is attempted.

traits.name: Cannibalistic Vitality (Ex)
traits.text: When a kuru hits a living creature with its bite attack, he gains 1 temporary hit point by ingesting the target's blood. This ability does not work on creatures that do not have blood.

traits.name: Bite Attack
traits.text: Kuru possess a natural bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Kuru can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Kuru are especially sensitive to bright light (kuru have light sensitivity).

traits.name: +2 Intelligence, -2 Constitution, +2 Charisma
traits.text: Lashunta are almost universally intelligent and eager to learn. As a result, lashunta gain a +2 bonus to Intelligence.

traits.name: Lashunta
traits.text: Lashunta are humanoid with the lashunta subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Lashunta are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Lashunta have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Lashunta begin play speaking Elven and Lashunta. Lashunta with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except Druidic and other secret languages).

traits.name: Knowledgeable
traits.text: A lashunta gains a +2 racial bonus to any one Knowledge skill.

traits.name: Lashunta Magic
traits.text: A lashunta possessing an Intelligence score of 11 or higher gains the following spell-like abilities: At will-daze, mage hand; 1/day-detect thoughts. The caster level for these effects is equal to the lashunta's class levels.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.text: A lashunta is able to mentally communicate with any creature within 30 feet with whom she shares a language. Otherwise this ability is identical to the telepathy ability.

traits.name: Sexual Dimorphism
traits.text: Male and female lashunta have very different body and personality types, more so than most humanoid species. Female lashunta, though beautiful and commanding (+2 Charisma), lack the males' rugged builds (-2 Constitution).

alternate_traits.name: Insidious Telepathy
alternate_traits.text: Some lashunta have a knack for manipulating the minds of those they communicate with telepathically. They gain a +1 racial bonus on Charisma-based skill checks to influence any creature with whom they are telepathically communicating. If a lashunta telepathically issues a command to a charmed or dominated creature, she gains a +1 racial bonus on Charisma checks to compel the creature to follow that order. This racial trait replaces lashunta magic. Source PZO9280

traits.name: +2 Constitution, +2 Strength
traits.text: Lizardfolk are strong and hardy. They gain +2 Strength and +2 Constitution.

traits.name: Type

traits.name: Medium

traits.name: Base Speed

traits.name: Languages

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Lizardfolk have tough scaly skin, granting them a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Swim
traits.text: Lizardfolk have a swim speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Natural Attacks - Bite
traits.text: Lizardfolk gain a natural bite attack, dealing damage equivalent to that of a creature two size categories lower than normal for their size (1d2 for Small races, 1d3 for Medium, etc.). traits.name: Natural Attacks - Claws
traits.text: Lizardfolk receive two claw attacks. These are primary natural attacks. The damage is based on the creature's size (1d4 for Medium creatures.)

traits.name: +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence, +2 Dexterity
traits.text: Locathahs are agile and intuitive, but they are more interested in travel and experiences than in academia.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Locathahs are humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Locathahs are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Slow Speed
traits.text: Locathahs have a base speed of 10 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Locathahs begin play speaking Aquan and Common. Locathahs with a high Intelligence score can choose from the following: Aklo, Draconic, Elven, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, and Halfling.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Locathahs have thick scales that provide a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Fast Swimmer (5 RP)
traits.text: Locathahs have a swim speed of 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Locathahs live in areas where sunlight illuminates the water, and they have low-light vision.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Locathahs have the aquatic subtype but can breathe both water and air.

alternate_traits.name: Blunt Head
alternate_traits.text: Some locathahs develop blunt, flat heads with sharp, needlelike teeth and well-muscled jaws. This head shape reduces their swim speed to 40 feet but provides the locathah with a bite attack. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d4 points of piercing damage. This racial trait modifies fast swimmer.

alternate_traits.name: Coastal Emissary
alternate_traits.text: Locathahs who dwell in sunlit coastal waters develop close ties with surface dwellers and become skilled negotiators. Once per day when attempting a Diplomacy or Sense Motive check, a locathah with this racial trait can roll twice and use the better result. This racial trait replaces low-light vision.

alternate_traits.name: Deep Dweller
alternate_traits.text: Locathahs living in deeper waters than coastal shallows have adapted to operating in darkness. Locathahs who have this racial trait gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet and light sensitivity. This racial trait replaces low-light vision.

alternate_traits.name: Powerful Smell
alternate_traits.text: Although all locathahs have a distinctly fishy odor out of the water, some locathahs have slimier skin that exudes a strong scent both above and below the waves. Locathahs who have this racial trait emit a terrible scent as a 15-foot aura that nearly every other creature finds offensive. This is a poison effect. All living creatures (except other locathahs and creatures with the stench ability) within the aura must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + half the locathah's character level + the locathah's Constitution modifier) or be sickened for 5 rounds. Creatures that succeed at the saving throw cannot be sickened by the same locathah's powerful smell for 24 hours. A delay poison or neutralize poison spell or similar effect removes the effect from the sickened creature. Due to their smell, locathahs with this racial trait have a -4 penalty on Stealth checks. This racial trait replaces natural armor.

alternate_traits.name: Strong Limbs
alternate_traits.text: Some locathahs have powerful legs that are very useful on land but limit their mobility underwater. These locathahs have a base land speed of 20 feet and a swim speed of 40 feet. This racial trait modifies fast swimmer and slow speed.

traits.text: Monkey goblins have a base speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Monkey goblins begin play speaking Goblin. Monkey goblins with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Gnoll, Gnome, Halfling, Orc.

traits.name: Fearless
traits.text: Monkey goblins gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear.

traits.name: Acrobatic
traits.text: Monkey goblins gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Stealth checks.

traits.name: Natural Climber
traits.text: Monkey goblins have a climb speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Monkey goblins can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Prehensile Tail
traits.text: Monkey goblins have long, flexible tails that they can use to carry objects. They cannot wield weapons with their tails, but the tails do allow them to retrieve small objects stowed on their persons as a swift action.

traits.name: +2 Charisma, +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, +4 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, -2 Strength
traits.text: Descended from ancient humans who were forever changed by the harsh lands in the depths of the earth, munavris have exceptional abilities.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Munavris are humanoids with the munavri subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Munavris are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Normal Speed
traits.text: Munavris have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Munavris begin play speaking Munavri. Munavris with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Aboleth, Aquan, Dark Folk, Draconic, Terran, and Undercommon.

traits.name: Spell Resistance
traits.text: A munavri possesses an amount of spell resistance that's equal to 8 + her total number of class levels.

traits.name: Senses
traits.text: Munavris have darkvision 120 feet.

traits.name: Telepathy (Su)
traits.text: A munavri is able to mentally communicate with other munavris within 60 feet.

traits.name: Light Blindness
traits.text: As deep underground dwellers, munavris suffer from light blindness. Abrupt exposure to any bright light blinds munavris for 1 round. On subsequent rounds, they are dazzled as long as they remain in the affected area.

traits.name: Advanced Object Reading (Su)
traits.text: A munavri can instantly learn how to use almost any device. She can cast object reading at will, divining secrets of an object's history and its use. Once per day, she can select one weapon, suit of armor, or spell-trigger item on which she has cast object reading. For a number of minutes that equal her level, she is considered proficient with that item, or can make use of the spell-trigger device as if she were a spellcaster of the appropriate class.

traits.name: -2 Strength, +2 Charisma, +2 Dexterity
traits.text: Naiads have elegant fey grace and beauty but have delicate builds.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Naiad are Fey with the Water subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Medium. Naiads are Medium creatures.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Naiads have a base speed of 30 feet and a swim speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Naiads begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Naiads that have high Intelligence scores are able to choose from any of the following bonus languages: Aklo, Aquan, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Sylvan, and any regional human tongue.

traits.name: Fey Nature
traits.text: Naiads have a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal and Knowledge (nature) checks.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: All Naiads can see twice as far as humans can in dim light.

traits.name: Inspiration (Su)
traits.text: A naiad can choose another intelligent creature to inspire by giving that creature a token (typically a lock of her hair). As long as the creature carries the naiad's token and retains her favor, that creature gains a +1 insight bonus on Will saving throws and Craft and Perform checks. The naiad retains a link to her token and its carrier as if she had cast a status spell on the carrier. The naiad can end this effect at any time as a free action. A single naiad can only inspire one other creature at a time in this manner.

traits.name: Water Bond (Su)
traits.text: A naiad gains strength from a pond, lake, river, or other body of fresh water by bonding with it. While within 300 yards of her bonded body of water, she gains a +1 insight bonus to Armor Class and a +1 racial bonus on saving throws (these bonuses are not included in the stats above). Once per day as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, a naiad can forge a bond with a body of fresh water.

traits.name: -2 Intelligence, +2 Constitution, -2 Charisma, +4 Strength
traits.text: +4 Str, +2 Con, -2 Int, -2 Cha

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Humanoid (giant)

traits.name: Large
traits.text: Large

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Normal

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Xenophobic (racial only)

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Ogres have a +3 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: 60 ft

traits.name: +2 Strength, -2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom
traits.text: Orang-pendaks are strong and intuitive, but not particularly clever. They gain +2 Strength and +2 Wisdom but suffer -2 Intelligence.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Orang-pendaks are humanoids with the orang-pendak subtype.

traits.name: Small
traits.text: Orang-pendaks are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Orang-pendaks have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Orang-pendaks begin play speaking Sasquatch. Orang-pendaks who have high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Common, Draconic, Goblin, Grippli, Sylvan, Vanaran, and Vishkanya. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

traits.name: Forest Walker (Ex)
traits.text: Orang-pendaks gain a +4 bonus on Climb and Stealth checks in forests and jungles.

traits.name: Simian Empathy (Ex)
traits.text: Orang-pendaks gain a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal and wild empathy checks with apes and monkeys.

traits.name: Tear Apart (Ex)
traits.text: Orang-pendaks have powerful upper bodies and gain a +2 racial bonus on Strength checks to break or burst an object. This bonus also applies on combat maneuver checks to sunder with their unarmed attacks.

traits.name: Own Two Feet (Ex)
traits.text: Orang-pendaks are extremely unnerved whenever they are riding another creature or on a vehicle, and they take a - 2 penalty on ability checks, attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks when doing so.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Orang-pendaks can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: -2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, +2 Intelligence
traits.text: Reborn samsarans are insightful and learn quickly, but their bodies tend to be frail. They gain +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Constitution.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Reborn samsarans are humanoids with the samsaran subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Reborn samsarans are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Reborn samsarans have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Reborn samsarans begin play speaking Common and Samsaran. Samsarans with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: any human language, Abyssal, Aquan, Auran, Celestial, Draconic, Giant, Ignan, Infernal, Nagaji, Tengu, and Terran.

traits.name: Psychic Attunement
traits.text: Reborn samsarans receive Psychic Virtuoso as a bonus feat at 1st level. Those who can't use occult skill unlocks at 1st level instead gain the Psychic Sensitivity feat as a bonus feat.

traits.name: Reborn Magic
traits.text: A reborn samsaran with a Charisma score of 11 or higher can cast the following spells (as per the psychic magic universal monster rule, using his Charisma modifier to determine the DCs): burst of insight (1 PE), detect psychic significance (0 PE), object reading (2 PE), and psychic reading (1 PE). The caster level is equal to the reborn samsaran's level. The reborn samsaran has a reservoir of 5 PE per day.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Reborn samsarans can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Aura Transparency (Ex)
traits.text: A reborn samsaran has difficulty hiding his psychic signatures. The DC of any skill check made to read his aura decreases by 5, and the check takes one-tenth as long as normal to perform.

traits.name: Psychic Learning (Su)
traits.text: When a reborn samsaran expends psychic energy to cast psychic reading to identify a humanoid's class, he temporarily treats two of the target's class skills as if they were class skills for him. He can use these skills untrained and gains a +2 insight bonus on such checks. These benefits last for 24 hours or until the reborn samsaran spends psychic energy to cast psychic reading again.

traits.name: +2 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma
traits.text: Reptoids are both manipulative and strong, but they're deliberate in their movements. They gain +2 Strength and +2 Charisma but suffer -2 Dexterity.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Reptoid are humanoids with the Reptoid and shapechanger subtypes.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Reptoids are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Reptoids have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: All reptoids begin play speaking Common and Reptoid. Reptoids with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except for secret languages, such as Druidic).

traits.name: Scales
traits.text: When in its natural form, a reptoid has a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Cold-Blooded (Ex)
traits.text: Reptoids receive a +2 racial saving throw bonus against mind-affecting effects and poison.

traits.name: Natural Weapons (Ex)
traits.text: When in its natural form, a reptoid has a bite attack and two claw attacks that deal 1d3 points of damage each.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Reptoids can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

traits.name: Change Shape (Su)
traits.text: A reptoid can assume the appearance of a specific single Medium humanoid. The reptoid always takes this specific form when it uses this ability. The reptoid gains a +10 racial bonus on Disguise checks to appear as that type of humanoid. This ability otherwise functions as alter self, except the reptoid does not adjust its ability scores. A reptoid can select a new humanoid form by spending 1 week preparing itself for the change, but can then no longer assume its previous humanoid form.

traits.name: Mental Potency (Ex)
traits.text: A reptoid's mental effects can affect more powerful creatures or a greater number of creatures than normal. Both the Hit Die limit and the total number of Hit Dice affected by each enchantment or illusion spell it casts increase by 1. For enchantment and illusion spells it casts that target a number of creatures greater than one, the number of creatures affected also increases by one (so a spell that targets one creature per level would be affected, but a spell that targets only one creature would not be). This ability stacks with the mesmerist's ability of the same name.

traits.name: +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence, +2 Strength
traits.text: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence. Rougarous are strong and alert, but simplistic.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Rougarou are humanoids with the shapechanger subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Medium. Rougarous are Medium creatures.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Rougarous have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Rougarous speak Common and their own racial language of Rougarou. Rougarous with high Intelligence scores can choose from these bonus languages: Aklo, Elven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, or Sylvan.

traits.name: Natural Weapon
traits.text: Rougarous have a bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage. This is a secondary attack if a rougarou wields a manufactured weapon.

traits.name: Senses
traits.text: Rougarous have low-light vision and the scent special ability.

traits.name: Change Shape (Su)
traits.text: A rougarou can change shape once per day into a wolf as a standard action, as beast shape I. A rougarou can revert to its true form as a swift action.

traits.name: +2 Wisdom, +2 Strength, -2 Charisma
traits.text: While sahuagin are powerful and cunning, they are repulsive creatures.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Sahuagin are monstrous humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Sahuagin are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Sahuagin have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Sahuagin begin play speaking Aquan and Common. Sahuagin with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aboleth, Abyssal, Aklo, Draconic, Giant, Goblin, and Infernal.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Sahuagin have a +3 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Fast Swimmer (5 RP)
traits.text: Sahuagin have a swim speed of 60 feet.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Sahuagin have a natural bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage. This bite is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the creature is wielding manufactured weapons.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Sahuagin have two claw attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage. These are primary natural attacks.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: Once per day, whenever a sahuagin takes damage, it can fly into a frenzy for 1 minute; gaining a +2 racial bonus to Constitution and Strength but a -2 penalty to AC.

traits.name: Blindsense
traits.text: Sahuagin have blindsense with a range of 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Sahuagin have darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Light Blindness
traits.text: Sahuagin have the light blindness trait.

traits.name: Speak with Sharks
traits.text: Sahuagin can communicate telepathically with sharks to a distance of 100 feet. This communication is limited to simple concepts, such as "attack," "come," and "defend."

alternate_traits.name: Sahuagin Song
alternate_traits.text: Sahuagin with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Perform (sing) checks and a +1 racial bonus on saves against language-dependent effects. This replaces speak with sharks. Source PPC:HftF

alternate_traits.name: Stoic Defender
alternate_traits.text: Once per day when a sahuagin with this racial trait takes damage, he can focus on remaining steadfast. For 1 minute, the sahuagin gains a +2 racial bonus to AC and a +2 racial bonus on Will saves. This replaces blood frenzy. Source PPC:HftF

traits.name: +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma
traits.text: Shabti have powerful bodies and presences to match. They gain +2 Constitution and +2 Charisma.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Shabti are outsiders with the native subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Shabti are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Shabti have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Shabti begin play speaking Common. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Shabti can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Immortal
traits.text: Shabti do not age naturally and cannot die of old age. While some might come into being at age categories other than adulthood, they never leave their original age category. Spells and effects that cause aging affect a shabti as normal.

traits.name: Immune to Undeath
traits.text: Shabti can't become undead. Spells and abilities that would transform a shabti into an undead creature have no effect.

traits.name: Resist Level Drain
traits.text: A shabti takes no penalties from energy drain effects, though he can still be killed if he accrues more negative levels than he has Hit Dice. After 24 hours, any negative levels a shabti takes are automatically removed without the need for an additional saving throw.

traits.name: Past Life Knowledge
traits.text: Shabti remember bits of their past lives. As a result, they treat all Knowledge skills as class skills.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: Shabti can use suggestion once per day as a spell-like ability, with the caster level equal to the shabti's class level.

traits.name: Shattered Soul
traits.text: Shabti who are killed are exceptionally difficult to return to life. Those who attempt to return a shabti to life using raise dead, resurrection, or similar spells must succeed at a caster level check equal to 10 + the shabti's Hit Dice. If this check fails, the spell fails and the caster can't return the shabti to life for the next 24 hours (though the caster can try again after this period).

alternate_traits.name: Blank Slate
alternate_traits.text: Some shabti are bereft of memories of their past lives but can accomplish great improvisations. Shabti with this racial trait can, once per day as a free action, treat any skill as though they had a number of ranks equal to half of their character levels for one skill check (minimum 1 rank). This racial trait replaces past life knowledge.

alternate_traits.name: Facsimile
alternate_traits.text: A few shabti are made with such skill they are nearly perfect copies of a mortal. Shabti with this racial trait appear to be human, save perhaps for minor features like unusual skin color. They count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells like charm person). This racial trait replaces immune to undeath and alters the native subtype.

alternate_traits.name: Pharaonic Will
alternate_traits.text: Rather than working to influence others, some shabti focus inward. Once per day as an immediate action after failing a save against a charm, compulsion, or fear effect, a shabti with this racial trait can reroll the save with a +2 racial bonus. This racial trait replaces spell-like ability.

alternate_traits.name: Soul Sympathy
alternate_traits.text: Crafted to suffer punishments intended for their masters, some shabti can use this mortal connection to serve as reciprocal conduits. As an immediate action after being afflicted by temporary negative levels, a shabti with this racial trait can force the creature that inflicted the negative levels to suffer the same cumulative penalties, hit point loss, and caster level reduction. The shabti can use this ability only on an enemy within 60 feet and can share penalties with only one creature at a time. The shabti can sever this link as a free action. This racial trait replaces resist level drain.

favored_class_options.text: Add 1/2 to the bard's bardic knowledge bonus.
Add 1/4 to the bloodrager's effective class level when determining the power of her bloodrager bloodline powers.
Add 1/6 rounds to the duration of the investigator's studied combat.
Add 1/5 to the bonus allies gain from shared séance. This doesn't increase the medium's séance boon.

Add one spell from the psychic spell list that isn't on the cleric spell list to the list of spells the oracle knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the oracle can cast.
Add 1/2 to the paladin's level when determining the effect of smite evil against incorporeal and ethereal creatures.
Add 1/4 to a single existing favored terrain bonus (maximum bonus +1 per favored terrain).

Add one spell from the psychic spell list that isn't on the shaman spell list to the list of spells the shaman knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the shaman can cast.
Add 1/2 to the skald's bardic knowledge bonus.
Add 1 foot to the limit of etheric tether. This includes how far the spiritualist's phantom can be before needing to concentrate and before the tether is broken.
Add 1/5 to the bonus allies gain from shared seance. This doesn’t increase the medium’s seance boon.

traits.name: -2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom
traits.text: Skinwalkers are well attuned to the natural order of things and value passion above reason. They gain +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence, and +2 to one physical ability score while shapechanged (1 RP). While in their bestial form, they gain a +2 racial bonus to either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (see Change Shape). Skinwalkers of specific heritages (see below) gain different ability score modifiers, as indicated.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Skinwalkers are humanoids with the skinwalker and shapechanger subtypes.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Skinwalkers are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Skinwalkers have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Skinwalkers speak Common. Skinwalkers with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).

traits.name: Animal-Minded
traits.text: Skinwalkers have a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal and wild empathy checks. Skinwalkers of specific heritages gain a +2 bonus to different checks as indicated.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: Skinwalkers with a Wisdom score of 11 or higher can use speak with animals once per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this ability is equal to the skinwalker's character level. Skinwalkers of specific heritages gain other spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision (Ex)
traits.text: Skinwalkers can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text:
A skinwalker can change shape to and from a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a skinwalker assumes bestial form, she can choose to gain one of the following features:

2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage

Darkvision to a range of 60 feet.

+1 racial bonus to natural armor.

alternate_traits.name: Beast Talker
alternate_traits.text: Some skinwalkers' ability to communicate with animals is stronger than their ability to transform. Such skinwalkers can only use their change shape ability once per day for 1 minute per level, but they can use their speak with animals spell-like ability at will. This racial trait alters the change shape and spell-like ability racial traits. [Source PZO9280]

favored_class_options.text: While in bestial form, add +1/4 to the alchemist's natural armor bonus from mutagens or +5 minutes duration to mutagen use.
Add +1 to the character's total number of rage rounds per day while in bestial form.
Add +1 to the character's total number of rage rounds per day while in bestial form.
Choose two of the following combat maneuvers: bullrush, dirty trick, grapple, or trip. Gain a +1 bonus to the character's CMD when resisting these two combat maneuvers.
Choose two of the following combat maneuvers: bullrush, dirty trick, grapple, or trip. Gain a +1 bonus to the character's CMD when resisting these two combat maneuvers.
Add +1/2 to the cleric's channeled energy total when affecting animals, magic beasts, and shapechangers.
Add +1 hit point or +1 skill rank to the hunter's animal companion. If the character ever replaces this companion, the new companion gains these bonus hit points and skill ranks.
Add +1 hit point or +1 skill rank to the hunter's animal companion. If the character ever replaces this companion, the new companion gains these bonus hit points and skill ranks.
Add +1/2 to Intimidate checks while in bestial form and +1/2 to Bluff checks to feint.
Add +1/2 to Intimidate checks while in bestial form and +1/2 to Bluff checks to feint.
Add +1/2 to the oracle's level for the purpose of determining the effects of the oracle's curse ability.
Add +1/2 to Intimidate checks while in bestial form and +1/2 to Bluff checks to feint.
Add +1/2 to Intimidate checks while in bestial form and +1/2 to Bluff checks to feint.
Add +1/4 to the skald's total number of raging song rounds per day.

Add +1/4 to the slayer's studied target bonus on Perception and Survival checks. When the slayer gains the stalker class feature, this increase also adds to the studied target bonus on Stealth checks.
Add one spell known from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. This spell must have the curse, emotion, or polymorph descriptor, and be at least one level below the highest spell level the mage can cast.
Add one spell known from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. This spell must have the curse, emotion, or polymorph descriptor, and be at least one level below the highest spell level the mage can cast.
Add 1/2 to the number of times per day the warpriest can use blessings, but the warpriest can use these additional blessings on only those from the Air, Animal, Charm, Magic, Plant, or Sun domains.

traits.name: +2 Wisdom, -2 Dexterity
traits.text: Syrinx are contemplative and patient, traits that make them somewhat slow to act. As a result, syrinx gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom but suffer a -2 penalty to Dexterity.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Syrinx are humanoids with the Syrinx subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Syrinx are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Syrinx have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Syrinx begin play speaking Syrinx. Syrinx with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Auran, Celestial, Strix, or Infernal.

traits.name: Pride
traits.text: Syrinx receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

traits.name: Nocturnal
traits.text: Syrinx gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks at night.

traits.name: Flight
traits.text: Syrinx have a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Syrinx can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Syrinx have darkvision and so can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Speak with Avians
traits.text: Syrinx can speak with all birds of the animal creature type and birdlike magical beasts (like phoenixes and thunderbirds).

alternate_traits.name: Oppressive
alternate_traits.text: Syrinxes often have a natural talent for sensing how to unsettle and oppress other creatures. As a swift action, a syrinx can attempt a Sense Motive check against a DC of 10 + a creature's Hit Dice + its Charisma modifier or a DC of 10 + the creature's Bluff modifier, whichever is higher. On a success, syrinx gains a +4 racial bonus on Intimidate checks against that target and a +1 racial bonus to the DC of any fear effects she uses against that target. This racial trait replaces nocturnal and pride. Source PZO9280

traits.name: +2 Wisdom, -2 Strength, +2 Constitution
traits.text: Triaxians are a hardy and wily race, as befits their constantly changing environment, but their lean forms have trouble maintaining large amounts of muscle mass. They gain +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, -2 Strength

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Triaxians are humanoids with the triaxian subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Triaxians are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Triaxians have a base speed of 30 ft.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Triaxians speak Triaxian. Triaxians with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages (except secret languages, such as Druidic).

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Triaxians can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

traits.name: Bonus Feat
traits.text: Triaxians select one extra feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Triaxians' unique ear construction grants them a +2 bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Seasoned (Ex)
traits.text: Choose summer or winter. If summer is chosen, the triaxian can exist comfortably in conditions between 90 and 110 degrees Fahrenheit without having to attempt Fortitude saves due to the environment. If winter is chosen, the triaxian can exist comfortably in conditions between 40 and 0 degrees Fahrenheit without having to attempt Fortitude saves. When in conditions of severe cold or heat, Triaxians have to attempt Fortitude saves only once per hour instead of once every 10 minutes. Transitional Triaxians do not have this ability.

alternate_traits.name: Transitional Lore
alternate_traits.text: Transitional triaxians are often instilled from a young age with the lore they need to prepare for the next winter or summer; they gain a +1 racial bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks. This racial trait replaces seasoned. Source PZO9280

traits.name: +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, -2 Dexterity
traits.text: Tritons are strong and have forceful personalities, but they are not very nimble.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Tritons are native outsiders with the water subtype.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Tritons are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Tritons are ungainly out of the water and have a base speed of only 5 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Tritons begin play speaking Aquan and Common. Tritons with a high Intelligence score can choose from the following: Aboleth, Aklo, Celestial, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, and Sylvan.

traits.name: Swim Speed
traits.text: Tritons have a swim speed of 40 feet.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability
traits.text: Tritons can cast summon nature's ally II once per day to summon either a small water elemental or 1d3 dolphins only.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Tritons have a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Tritons have darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Tritons have low-light vision.

traits.name: -2 Intelligence, +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom
traits.text: Vine leshys are hardy and insightful, but sometimes forgetful. They gain a +2 bonus to Constitution and Wisdom but suffer a -2 penalty to Intelligence.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Vine leshys are plants with the leshy subtype but lack the immunities to mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, and stunning that the plant type usually grants, and they lack the immunity to electricity and sonic that the leshy subtype usually grants.

traits.name: Small
traits.text: Vine leshys are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Vine leshys have a base speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Vine leshys begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Vine leshys with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aquan, Auran, Aklo, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Terran, or Undercommon.

traits.name: Unassuming Foliage
traits.text: Vine leshys gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in forests.

traits.name: Climber
traits.text: Vine leshys gain a +2 racial bonus on Climb checks.

traits.name: Pass without Trace
traits.text: Vine leshys have pass without trace as a constant spell-like ability (caster level 2nd).

traits.name: Plantspeech
traits.text: Vine leshys can speak with vines as if subject to a continual speak with plants spell.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Vine leshys can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Vine leshys can see twice as far as humans under conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: Vine leshys can transform into vines, with results similar to tree shape. In this form, the leshy appears as a particularly healthy Small vine. The leshy can assume plant form or revert to its true form as a swift action.

traits.name: Verdant Burst
traits.text: When slain, a vine leshy explodes in a burst of fertile energies. All plant creatures within 30 feet of the slain leshy regain hit 1d8 points, and vines quickly infest the area. If the terrain can support vines, the undergrowth is dense enough to make the region into difficult terrain for 24 hours, after which the plant life diminishes to a normal level; otherwise, this plant life has no significant effect on movement and withers and dies within an hour.

alternate_traits.name: Agile
alternate_traits.text: Vine leshys are quicker but less tough than a typical vine leshy. Replace the leshy's +2 racial bonus to Constitution with a +2 racial bonus to Dexterity. This alters the vine leshy's ability scores.

alternate_traits.name: Curiosity
alternate_traits.text: Vine leshys bearing gregarious spirits are more suited to learn about other cultures. They always treat Diplomacy and Linguistics as class skills, and they gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Linguistics checks. This replaces pass without trace and plantspeech. Source PPC:WO

alternate_traits.name: Grapevine
alternate_traits.text: A vine leshy made from a grapevine can produce magically infused fruit that can heal her allies. She can cast goodberry once per day as a spell-like ability, with a caster level equal to her character level. This replaces pass without trace.

alternate_traits.name: Lashvine
alternate_traits.text: Some vine leshys can sprout whip-like appendages. These individuals gain proficiency with whips and scorpion whips. As a free action, the vine leshy can turn one hand into a lashvine. A lashvine is a primary natural attack that deals 1d3 points of bludgeoning damage. A lashvine cannot hold items, wield weapons, or perform fine manipulation. This replaces change shape and verdant burst. Source PPC:WO

alternate_traits.name: Poisonous
alternate_traits.text: Vine leshys made from poison ivy vines carry natural poison in their bodies. As a swift action, the leshy can imbue its vines with this irritating substance. The next time the leshy hits a creature with an unarmed strike, the creature is affected by the following poison. Vine Leshy Toxin: Unarmed strike-injury; save Fort DC 10 + half the vine leshy's Hit Dice + the leshy's Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect sickened for 1 round; cure 1 save. The leshy can use this ability a number of times per day equal to its Constitution modifier (minimum 1). A vine leshy is immune to its own poison, but not to those of other vine leshys. This replaces plantspeech and change shape.

alternate_traits.name: Seasoned Spirit
alternate_traits.text: Longlived vine leshys are less flexible, but they have established stronger bonds with the natural world. These leshys can spend an hour in concentration to cast speak with plants as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to their character level. This alters plantspeech and replaces climber and unassuming foliage. Source PPC:WO

alternate_traits.name: Swamp Leshy
alternate_traits.text: Some vine leshys are made from plants that naturally grow in swamps. These leshys gain a +2 racial bonus on Swim checks and a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in swamps. This replaces climber and alters unassuming foliage.

alternate_traits.name: Writhing Eye
alternate_traits.text: Some vine leshys can grow thin vines that serve as sensory organs. Growing or controlling the vine is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. The vine can extend up to 15 feet and is small enough to pass through a keyhole. A leshy can perceive, using all of her senses, within 20 feet of the vine's tip. This replaces darkvision and low-light vision. Source PPC:WO

favored_class_options.text: Add 1/4 to the alchemist's natural armor bonus when using his mutagen.
Add a +1/3 bonus to Perform (oratory) checks, including checks using versatile performance, as long as the bard first spends at least 10 minutes telling a story.
Add a +1/2 bonus to the druid's wild empathy or plant empathy checks.
Gain 1/5 of the Extra Wild Talent feat. This feat must be spent on a wood-element talent.

An oracle with the nature or wood mystery adds one spell from the druid's spell list that isn't on the cleric spell list to the oracle's spell list; she still must select this spell as one of her spells known in order to cast it. This spell must be at least 1 level lower than the highest spell level the oracle can cast.
Add a +1/2 bonus to Knowledge (nature) checks in the ranger's favored terrain.
Add a +1/2 bonus to Climb checks and on Stealth checks in forests.

Shamans with the nature or wood spirit add one spell from the druid's spell list that isn't on the shaman spell list to the shaman's spell list; she still must select this spell as one of her spells known in order to cast it. This spell must be at least 1 level lower than the highest spell level the shaman can cast.

Add a +1 bonus on Knowledge (nature) checks relating to plants.

traits.name: +2 Intelligence, +2 Constitution, -2 Wisdom
traits.text: +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, -2 Wisdom.

traits.name: Type
traits.text: Yaddithians are Aberrations.

traits.name: Medium
traits.text: Yaddithians are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

traits.name: Base Speed
traits.text: Yaddithians have a land speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.text: Yaddithians begin play speaking Yaddithian. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose any language as a bonus language.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Yaddithians can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: A Yaddithian has two claws that deal 1d4 points of damage each.

traits.name: Defensive Abilities
traits.text: Yaddithians have cold resistance 5 and the no breath ability.

traits.name: Rugose
traits.text: A Yaddithian gains a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Cosmic Mind (Ex)
traits.text: A Yaddithian gets a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge and Spellcraft checks. A yaddithian spellcaster who would store spells in a spellbook or familiar instead stores those spells in its mind (but must expend the normal resources to learn new spells).

traits.name: Long-Lived (Ex)
traits.text: Yaddithians live for thousands of years; they gain no benefit or penalty from aging and are immune to magical aging effects.
